title: Berries with Banana Cream
instructions: Mash the banana into the yogurt and orange juice until mostly smooth.
Divide the strawberries into serving dishes. Spoon the banana cream over them, then finish with honey and cinnamon.

title: Crunchy Berry Parfait
instructions: Spoon the yogurt into a glass or bowl.
Layer the berries over the yogurt and sprinkle with granola.

title: Bean Burrito Bowl

lines.text: 2 cans low-sodium pinto beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Add the beans, onion, spices, water and tomato paste to a saucepan. Simmer uncovered over medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir cilantro into the cooked rice. Spoon rice into bowls, then add the seasoned beans, cheese and salsa.

title: Sauteed Cabbage and Onion
instructions: Warm the oil in a wide pan and cook the sliced onion over medium heat for 5–6 minutes, until light golden.
Add the cabbage, salt, black pepper and caraway. Toss and cook 3–5 more minutes.
license: Famara directions adapted from the credited USDA recipe

title: Zesty Orange Carrots

lines.text: 16 ounces carrots, cut into ¼ inch strips

instructions: Simmer the carrot strips and cinnamon in about 2 cups of water for 10 minutes, until just tender.
While the carrots cook, grate the orange zest and squeeze the juice. Drain the carrots and toss them with the juice, zest, honey and butter. Sprinkle with parsley if using.

title: Chicken Alfredo With a Twist

lines.text: 2 ½ cups dry whole-wheat rotini pasta (10 ounces)
2 cans low-fat, reduced-sodium cream of chicken soup (10¾ ounces each)
1 ⅓ cups fat-free half and half

instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Stir in the rotini and cook uncovered for 8–10 minutes, until tender. Drain.

In a separate pot, stir together the soup, half-and-half, white pepper, garlic powder, Parmesan and cooked chicken. Stir over medium heat for about 5 minutes, until the sauce reaches 165°F for 15 seconds.
Toss the pasta and sauce together just before serving.

title: Cheese and Corn Chowder
instructions: Cover the potatoes, carrots, celery, onion and pepper with the listed water in a pot. Cover the pot and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the corn and simmer for another 5 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Lower the heat before adding milk and cheddar. Stir gently until the cheese melts and the soup is hot.

title: Curried Potatoes

lines.text: 3 cups potatoes, peeled and chopped into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, 10–15 minutes, then drain and briefly cool in cold water.
Soften the onion in butter over medium heat. Drain the potatoes again, add to the skillet and toss to coat.
Add broth, curry powder and lemon juice. Cook until most of the broth is absorbed.

title: Oven Fried Fish

lines.text: 1 pound tilapia fillets, fresh or frozen and thawed (4 fillets)

instructions: Heat the oven to 350°F. Beat the salt and pepper into the egg and put the breadcrumbs in a separate dish.
Dip the tilapia into the egg, followed by the bread crumbs. Coat a shallow baking pan with the melted butter and arrange the fish in one layer.
Bake uncovered for 15–20 minutes, until the fish flakes and reaches 145°F in the center. Serve with lemon if using.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet and cook the celery and onion for 2 minutes.
Stir in the frozen vegetables and cook until heated through and crisp-tender. Add the cooked rice, soy sauce and pepper, and stir for 2 minutes more.
license: Famara directions adapted from the credited USDA recipe

title: Oven Baked Sweet Potato Fries

lines.text: 3 medium sweet potatoes, about 5 inches long
salt and black pepper to taste

instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Peel the sweet potatoes and slice into ¼-inch pieces.
Coat with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Add the paprika and garlic powder if using.
Spread out on a baking sheet and roast for about 20 minutes, turning the pieces so they brown evenly.

title: Fruit Salad with Yogurt
instructions: Toss the fruit with pineapple juice and let stand for 15 minutes.
Spoon into four dishes, add yogurt to each and finish with the almonds.
license: Famara directions adapted from the credited USDA recipe

title: Oatmeal Griddle Cakes
instructions: Heat the milk, pour it over the oats and allow the mix to cool.
Whisk together flour, baking powder and salt. Separate the eggs. Stir the yolks and melted butter into the oats, followed by the dry ingredients.
Beat the egg whites until stiff and fold them into the batter. Spoon onto a hot greased griddle. Flip when the tops bubble and brown on the other side.

title: Harvest Vegetable Salad

lines.text: 1 parsnip, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces
1 carrot, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Divide the arugula and cilantro among four plates. Bring 1 quart of water to a boil, add the parsnip, carrot and turnip, then simmer for 2 minutes and drain.
Whisk the lime juice and zest with the sugar, chili powder and olive oil.
Scatter the warm vegetables over the greens, drizzle with dressing and add walnuts and blue cheese if using.

title: Huevos Rancheros with Salsa
instructions: Set the oven to 450°F. Brush the tortillas lightly with oil and bake for 3–5 minutes until the edges crisp.
Scramble the eggs with black pepper in a lightly oiled skillet until set.
Divide the eggs among the tortillas, top with cheese and broil for about 2 minutes. Spoon salsa over each tortilla.

title: Teriyaki Lettuce Wraps

lines.text: ½ cup reduced sodium teriyaki sauce
1 cup frozen peas and carrots, thawed (optional)

instructions: Whisk the water, cornstarch and teriyaki sauce. Mix with the ground turkey, water chestnuts and thawed peas and carrots.
Heat the oil in a skillet. Add the turkey mixture and stir, breaking up the meat, until the sauce thickens and the turkey reaches 165°F.
Spoon the hot filling into lettuce leaves.

title: Macaroni Chickpea Soup

lines.text: 1 can low-sodium chickpeas (garbanzo), drained and rinsed (15 ounces)

instructions: Bring the broth and water to a boil. Add the macaroni, onion powder and oregano, then simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, green beans, chickpeas and garlic powder. Simmer about 5 more minutes, until the pasta and beans are tender.

title: Baked Chicken Nuggets

lines.text: 1 ½ pounds chicken thighs, boneless, skinless

instructions: Heat the oven to 400°F and lightly grease a baking sheet.
Crush the corn flakes and mix them with the paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder and onion powder. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and coat each piece with the crumbs.
Arrange the nuggets in one layer. Bake for 12–14 minutes, until golden and the chicken reaches 165°F.

title: Pumpkin Soup

lines.text: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed (15 ounces)
salt and black pepper to taste

instructions: Blend the white beans, chopped onion and water into a puree.
Transfer to a pot and stir in the pumpkin, broth, thyme, salt and pepper. Cover and simmer gently for 15–20 minutes.

title: Black Bean Salsa

lines.text: 1 can low-sodium black beans, drained and rinsed (15.5 ounces)
2 cans low-sodium diced tomatoes, drained (14.5 ounces each)

instructions: Toss drained beans and tomatoes with the diced peppers, onion and garlic.
Whisk together the cumin, cilantro and rice vinegar. Pour over the vegetables and mix well.

title: Aromatic Sauteed Spinach and Peppers

lines.text: 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, peeled and minced (or ½ teaspoon ground ginger)
¼ cup canned no-salt-added tomato paste

instructions: Melt butter over medium heat. Stir in onion, bell pepper, garlic, ginger and pepper flakes for 3 minutes.
Add the spinach. When the leaves start to collapse, stir in the tomato paste and salt. Cook over medium-high heat for about 1 minute more.

title: Tomato Basil Soup

lines.text: ⅛ teaspoon red pepper flakes (or to taste)
salt and black pepper to taste

instructions: Cook the onion in olive oil for about 4 minutes. Add garlic and stir for 1 minute, then add tomatoes and cook uncovered for 10 minutes.
Blend about three quarters of the tomatoes until smooth. Return the puree to the pan.
Stir in the milk, basil and pepper flakes. Heat gently without boiling, then season with salt and pepper.

title: Tuna Melt
instructions: Drain the tuna and flake it into a bowl. Add celery, mayonnaise, dried onion, salt and pepper.
Divide the mixture between 2 slices of toast and cover with the cheese. Broil until the cheese melts, keeping an eye on the bread.
Serve open-faced or cover with the remaining toast.

title: Turkey Patties
instructions: Combine turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, green onion and mustard. Shape into four patties about ½ inch thick.
Heat the oil in a skillet. Cook the patties for about 10 minutes, turning once, until the centers reach 165°F.

title: Zesty Zucchini Skillet
instructions: Simmer the tomato juice with the black pepper over high heat for 3 minutes.
Add the red onion, tomato, mushrooms and basil if using. Cover and cook over medium-high heat for 5 minutes.
Stir in the zucchini, cover again and cook for 5–7 minutes, until tender.
